cards.title: Precise expanding shockwave
cards.architecture: One definition: a horizontal annulus billboard. Multiple definitions only for dust/debris accompaniment.
cards.implementation: Use emitter_transform_xz, one instant child, zero speed and a finite 0.9 s child lifetime. The original texture paints radius at 0.85, so divide half extents by 0.85. Fade alpha independently; do not move particles radially to approximate a continuous ring.
cards.performance: One large blended quad can cause overdraw despite one-particle count; check ground offset and distant readability.
limitations: The original demonstration targets an eight-block ring centerline radius; raster antialiasing gives it finite thickness. Preview perspective turns a world circle into a screen ellipse.

cards.title: Vortex, tornado and helix
cards.architecture: One parametric definition for motes; add debris/cloud layers for a full tornado.
cards.implementation: Use a fixed particle_random phase and an age-derived angle. Separate vertical drift from radial widening. For a funnel, set r(y) to a designed profile and distribute vertical starting positions; the supplied original demonstrates an expanding rising spiral, not volumetric fluid simulation.
cards.performance: Use fewer distinct sprites for the outer silhouette and denser tiny motes; avoid per-tick server motion.
limitations: A particle path is deterministic conditional on its random seed; Minecraft seeds need not match preview seeds.

cards.title: Large directional blizzard
cards.architecture: Two definitions and a simultaneous sequence: drifting flakes plus sparse wind streaks.
cards.implementation: Emit across a broad box; place the upstream volume to create arrival time. Use small near/far flakes and a second material/shape layer for gust readability. Both density/caps use a bounded quality input, defaulting to standard.
cards.performance: At standard quality flakes approach 660 alive per emitter; high quality approaches 990, before concurrent actors. Profile large transparent volumes.
limitations: No true wind field or terrain occlusion is simulated. Detached script sequence origins remain fixed.

cards.title: Electrical arcs and lightning
cards.architecture: One authored jagged sprite for a vertical flash; multiple oriented definitions/scripts for arbitrary endpoints.
cards.implementation: The original vertical flash uses a jagged white texture with a finite 0.22 s tail. For arbitrary endpoints, compute a stable basis and author segment direction/length inputs or a verified locator/animation orientation. Avoid treating a stretched straight streak as a bent 3D arc.
cards.performance: Sparse bright flashes read strongly; additive overlap can saturate. Cap concurrent arc segments.
limitations: The example is a static jagged billboard flash, not a general arbitrary-endpoint 3D lightning solver.

cards.title: Layered magical portal
cards.architecture: Three definitions started together; controller ownership for an attached persistent portal.
cards.implementation: Use a dark/translucent core for depth, an original rune ring for silhouette and orbiting motes for motion. Place layers at separate depth offsets. Keep color palette and fade clocks coherent. Preview each independently and all three together.
cards.performance: Preserve ring/core at low quality; reduce motes first. Large overlapping quads dominate overdraw.
limitations: A billboard portal has a preferred plane. Crossing it or rotating an attached portal requires engine/actor tests.

cards.title: Energy beam
cards.architecture: One planar energy sprite; crossed planes or oriented segments for a beam visible from more directions.
cards.implementation: The original example is a fixed plane strip. Arbitrary endpoints need an oriented animation/locator or verified direction input. Size is half the visible length after sprite margins. Add a separate impact definition; do not scale rate to control beam length.
cards.performance: A few long quads may cover much of the screen. Test oblique and rear viewpoints before promising a cylindrical beam.
limitations: The included fixed-plane example is not a fully dynamic endpoint beam; its limitation is explicit.

cards.title: Debris, smoke and sparks explosion
cards.architecture: Four definitions with staggered cues; particle events can own a simpler fixed sequence.
cards.formula: Impact at 0; debris at 0.08 s; smoke at 0.15 s; totalTail=max(cue+childLife).
cards.implementation: Keep a readable sharp impact before the slow smoke rise. Sparks move outward and drag; debris uses gravity/collision; smoke grows and fades. Each material/motion layer owns its finite lifetime.
cards.performance: Reduce accents without removing the impact silhouette. Collision debris requires block-world profiling.
limitations: Preview disables real block collisions. No gameplay explosion/damage is performed by the VFX sample.

cards.architecture: A finite slash billboard plus a world-space trail; animation locator or bounded script sampling for attachment.

cards.title: Staged boss ability
cards.architecture: Seven cues via bounded Script API sequence; animation synchronization may be a better owner in a real boss.
cards.formula: Warning 0–1.5 s; strike 1.5 s; radial impact 1.6 s; aftermath 1.7–4.05 s.
cards.implementation: The sample snapshots one origin, guards against overlapping casts by owner and checks validity before delayed cues. A real gameplay telegraph must match attack geometry and damage timing. Keep visible warning and impact at all quality tiers.
cards.performance: Budget overlapping tails and simultaneous bosses; cancel pending jobs on owner loss.
limitations: This sample creates visual cues only. It is not a damage ability or a tested multiplayer boss system.

cards.title: Animated symbols and glyphs
cards.architecture: One rune definition for rotation/pulse; a flipbook for changing symbol frames; multiple layers for independent symbols.
cards.formula: phi=omega*age; atlasCell=floor(fps*age) subject to the verified count/loop rule.
cards.implementation: Use an original high-contrast transparent glyph and preserve its reading plane. Separate glyph scale from aura glow. If changing symbols, generate known-size atlas cells rather than inferring them from an arbitrary tall PNG.
cards.performance: Keep symbols readable at the intended distance; aggressive alpha fades can erase small strokes.
limitations: The original rune animates rotation/fade. A changing glyph atlas is a derived variant, not an untested included asset.

cards.title: Animated flame
cards.architecture: One finite steady emitter with original eight-frame vertical atlas.
cards.formula: Frame pixels=(32,32); PNG=(32,256); step=(0,32); max_frame=8; fps=10.
cards.implementation: Use white tint on the painted flame atlas, upward speed/acceleration and shrinking/fading children. Rate and cap scale together with quality. Validate each mapped cell and preview animation differences; one screenshot does not prove frame order.
cards.performance: Preserve core flame shape while scaling accents; blended overlap can become opaque at high rates.
limitations: Use pinned frame-count semantics; tutorial wording differs. Light emission is not created just by a bright texture.

cards.architecture: One droplet burst; add a horizontal ring and mist for a layered splash.

cards.title: Smoke growth and fade

cards.title: Environmental dust
cards.architecture: A broad low-height steady volume with finite exposure; state-owned looping variant for ambient environments.
cards.formula: Density≈rate*life; lateral drift plus a low alpha envelope.
cards.implementation: Keep scale small enough to read as dust while distributing across the scene. Use local/world ownership appropriate to a moving environment. Maintain a finite default to avoid leaving endless ambient emitters after a command.
cards.performance: Scale density by area and observer distance; avoid repeatedly spawn a whole volume for every player tick.
limitations: No automatic biome/weather trigger is added. Connect through existing environment ownership.

cards.title: Particle-event cinematic
cards.architecture: A zero-child root emitter with timeline events; scripts/animations for actor-aware/gameplay stages.
cards.formula: timeline keys are absolute emitter seconds; sequence event nodes execute together, not as delays.
cards.implementation: Use named events pointing to actual identifiers and explicit type emitter. Child variables do not automatically inherit root inputs. Keep root emission finite and child tails bounded. Verify every secondary edge and preview the whole chain.
cards.performance: Sum overlapping child counts and tails; the zero-child root still creates emitters.
limitations: Audio and actor-binding require context; this original event sequence contains no sound or inherited parameter assumptions.
